_comment: Measured wall-clock seconds per bats file on a GitHub windows-latest runner, Node 20, 2026-07-30 (run 30569500717). Used ONLY to balance CI shards -- never to gate anything. Stale numbers cost balance, never correctness: shard-tests.mjs asserts every file lands in exactly one shard whether or not it appears here.
_why: arc-ci's windows leg took 22.5 minutes against 2 on ubuntu. Not one slow file -- the top 3 are 32% and the top 10 are 64%. Windows costs 2.80s/test against ubuntu's 0.25s because every bats `run` spawns a process. Systemic, so the fix is splitting rather than fixing.
